questions.inline:
Report inline-example. Input 47. Answer -4. Incorrect. Input 52. Abstained. Input 61. Answer 10. Correct.
Using the report above, what were the recorded inputs and outcomes? Cite the containing record_id once. Copy each observed answer exactly as written. Return one fenced JSON object with "record_id" and "rows", where each row is [input integer, answer as a JSON integer or null, outcome as one of "correct", "incorrect", or "abstained"]. Use record_id null and empty rows if there is no report.
